item.title: ‘Objectively failing’ — Real estate leaders call for data-first strategy
item.description: The message was clear — the data is out there. The competitive advantage will belong to those willing to clean it, interpret it and act.

item.title: Dono raises $6.5M to expand property records platform
item.description: Property records platform Dono has raised $6.5 million in a seed round to support geographic expansion and broaden its customer base beyond title insurance.

item.title: Figure CEO Michael Tannenbaum on partnering with Bed Bath & Beyond
item.description: Figure Technologies will power home loans for Bed Bath & Beyond’s planned finance platform, set to launch in mid-2026.

item.title: Optimal Blue mortgage data shows 50% refi jump in January as rates dip
item.description: Falling mortgage rates in January 2026 pushed refinance volume up 50% and increased the VA lending share, per Optimal Blue data.

item.title: Brokerage leaders express optimism for 2026 housing market conditions
item.description: Delta Media’s 2026 survey finds 85% of brokerage leaders expect higher profits and 62% forsee stronger housing demand.

item.title: Barry Habib, Logan Mohtashami say housing market set for pent-up demand surge
item.description: With pent-up demand, multi-generational buyers and a suppressed market, 2026 could be a landmark year for U.S. housing.

item.title: Why title integrity needs decentralized governance
item.description: On-chain governance protocols can secure U.S. land records by closing gaps left by static databases and manual oversight.

item.title: Pennymac leader on policy shifts to ease homeownership barriers
item.description: As Congress prepares for hearings on mortgage finance and affordability, industry leaders are bracing for months of policy debate.

item.title: Zillow returns to profitability in 2025 as mortgage and rentals drive growth
item.description: Zillow Group achieved 16% revenue growth and $23 million in net income in 2025, with its mortgage and rental segments leading the gains.

item.title: Mutual of Omaha hires veteran Tommy Noyes for reverse wholesale role
item.description: Tommy Noyes has joined Mutual of Omaha Mortgage from Liberty Reverse Mortgage as a national wholesale account executive for Mutual's reverse mortgage business.
